# StudyIt // Distraction-Free Study Workstation & Knowledge Hub

> Official AI & LLM Context Manifest for https://studyitpi.vercel.app/

## Project Information
- **Name**: StudyIt
- **Author**: Arfa Danial (@nyzxis)
- **Author Portfolio**: https://nyzxis.vercel.app/
- **Live Application**: https://studyitpi.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/nyzxis/studyit

## Overview
StudyIt is a calm, distraction-free desktop productivity and study workstation built for students and lifelong learners. It integrates active recall study topics, interactive self-tests, a Pomodoro timer, ambient lo-fi audio, and a progress dock to lock in subject mastery.

## Features & Architecture
- **Interactive Subject & Topic Decks**: Structured modular subjects with subtopics and mastery checkpoints.
- **Active Recall Self-Tests**: Randomized practice quizzes verifying retention.
- **Pomodoro Focus Timer**: Built-in 25-minute focus intervals and 5-minute restorative breaks.
- **Ambient Lo-Fi Audio**: Integrated distraction-free soundscapes.
- **Persistence**: Local browser storage caching session progress, notes, and completed study badges.
